title: Pointed etale stages map flatly to their colimit completion
statement: Let R be a Noetherian commutative local ring and K a chosen separable closure of its residue field, with compatible R-algebra structure. Let P be the full subcategory of etale R-algebras pointed in K, as in def-sc-ring-strict-henselization, and D its forgetful functor to commutative R-algebras. For any colimit cocone c on D and any object t of P, the composite from the underlying algebra of t through c.pt to the completion of c.pt at m_R c.pt is flat.

source.place: Tag 06LJ, proof of (c), paragraph beginning To finish the proof of (c)

proof.text: Use the equivalence between pointed etale algebras and etale residue triples: the prime is the kernel of S → K and its residue embedding is the induced map on the fraction field of S/q. Translate the local residue field R/m to the scheme residue field at the maximal ideal via the canonical field isomorphism. This translation preserves the chosen map from R to K.

Transport c along this equivalence and forget its R-algebra structure. The underlying ring cocone is a colimit: the nonempty filtered diagram gives the base action on any ring cocone from any one coprojection; filteredness makes it independent of that choice, and the ring descent is therefore an algebra descent. Structural compatibility of each coprojection gives hρ in the triple flatness lemma.

Apply etaleTriple_to_strictHenselization_completion_flat to the transported cocone and the triple of t. The structural map is algebraMap R c.pt, so its extended ideal is exactly m_R c.pt. The forgetful equivalence retains the same ring and coprojection, identifying the resulting map with the displayed composite.

theorem pointedEtale_completion_stage_flat
    (R K : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [Field K]
    [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) K]
    [IsSepClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) K] [Algebra R K]
    [IsScalarTower R (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) K]
    (c : Cocone ((ObjectProperty.ι
      (fun X : Over (CommAlgCat.of R K) ↦ Etale R X.left)) ⋙
        Over.forget (CommAlgCat.of R K)))
    (hc : IsColimit c)
    (t : ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory
      (fun X : Over (CommAlgCat.of R K) ↦ Etale R X.left)) :
    ((algebraMap c.pt
      (AdicCompletion ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R c.pt)) c.pt)).comp
        (c.ι.app t).hom.toRingHom).Flat
